description: This file defines the properties for configuring an HTTP protocol adapter in the Hono framework, including the realm used for authentication prompts.

classes.name: HttpProtocolAdapterProperties
classes.description: Properties class for configuring an HTTP protocol adapter, including realm configuration.

methods.name: getRealm
methods.description: Returns the name of the realm used in WWW-Authenticate headers for unauthenticated devices.

methods.name: setRealm
methods.description: Sets the realm name for unauthenticated devices, ensuring it is not null.
